findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_template" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns one AnimatedWebs template by slug: description, stack, tags, access level, tools it works with, licence note, demo and preview URLs, views, saves and li…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.animatedwebs.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_template, get_component, get_background, get_creator, get_pricing, get_account, request_template · Private data: get_component, generate_component, refine_component, get_background, get_style_reference, get_account, manage_request · Public sink: manage_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_template, get_component, get_background, get_creator, get_pricing, get_account, request_template · Private data: get_component, generate_component, refine_component, get_background, get_style_reference, get_account, manage_request · Public sink: manage_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
